hero.title: Let’s build something people love.
hero.subtitle: Tell me about your product, audience, and goals — I’ll get back to you within 24 hours.

faqs.a: 2–10 weeks depending on scope. I ship weekly increments with clear milestones.

faqs.q: Do you work with dev teams?
faqs.a: Yes — I partner closely with engineering. I provide specs, tokens, and motion blueprints.

faqs.q: What tools do you design in?
faqs.a: Figma for design & systems, Framer for interactions, Lottie for motion when needed.
